why_it_moved.text: Successful Search Rate rose 0.81% overall, but no single segment (device or query type) shows a clear gain on its own; the lift is spread thinly.
why_it_moved.label: measured

why_it_moved.text: Reformulation Rate rose 0.96%, mostly on informational queries (+1.70%), so some users may be re-searching after the new ranker's first page.
why_it_moved.label: inferred

why_it_moved.text: The mechanism behind the lift is unknown; the new ranker model is the only config difference.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: The pre period could not be checked; a pre-exposure comparison showing the arms already differed on Successful Search Rate would void the lift.
A daily series by days since first exposure showing the effect fading would mean the lift is a novelty effect, since the novelty check could not run.
Reformulation Rate still rising on informational queries in a longer run would show that some of the gain is users searching again.
